channel.title: Cadence 步频 — PT Research Signal
channel.description: Daily curated physical therapy & rehab research for clinicians. AI-scored signal from 50 sources.

item.title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline for Physical Therapist Management After TKA
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has published an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) for osteoarthritis, offering evidence-based recommendations for various aspects of care.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Measurements and management of multiple sclerosis-related fatigue: an umbrella review and meta-analysis.
item.description: An umbrella review and meta-analysis of 46 systematic reviews found that exercise provided the most consistent benefit for MS-related fatigue, with aerobic training showing a modest reduction (SMD -0.32) and resistance exercise a significant reduction (SMD -1.09).
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
item.description: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses synthesized evidence on structured exercise training for fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, comparing effects across exercise modalities and fatigue instruments.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has released a revised clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, based on a systematic review of current scientific literature, featuring 20 recommendations.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effects of sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the effects of Sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk.
item.author: BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil

item.title: First trial confirms swimming reduces disability from chronic back pain
item.description: The EduSwim clinical trial, guided by a physiotherapist, found an eight-week individualized program of swimming and education significantly improved function and pain in people with chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
item.author: Medical Dialogues

item.title: APTA Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series (2026)
item.description: APTA's Health Policy and Payment team will provide an overview of the most significant federal regulatory and commercial payer policy updates for 2026, crucial for physical therapists' practice.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Proposed '27 Home Health Rule: 2.4% Increase Likely Reduced by PDGM Adjustments
item.description: CMS has proposed updates to the Calendar Year 2027 Home Health Prospective Payment System, indicating a 2.4% payment increase that is likely to be reduced by PDGM adjustments, with comments due by August 31, 2026.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Local Coverage Determinations
item.description: CMS outlines Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), defining them as determinations by fiscal intermediaries or carriers regarding Medicare Part A or Part B service coverage, and provides resources on the LCD process modernization.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Effect of Combined Aerobic and Resistance Training on Exercise Capacity, Muscle Strength, Quality of Life, and Mortality in Patients with Coronary Heart Disease: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
item.description: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that combined aerobic and resistance training (CART) significantly improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and reduces mortality in patients with coronary heart disease.
item.author: Sports Med - Open

item.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 2
item.description: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule includes plans to reshape the Medicare Quality Payment Program by ending the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) in 2029.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial found that adding 3 months of tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy for Parkinson's disease patients resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months, compared to device-aided therapy alone.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
item.description: A machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke was externally validated in an independent Danish prospective cohort, demonstrating its clinical reliability beyond its initial development cohort.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to conventional physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain improved pain and function over 12 weeks, but did not significantly affect fear-avoidance beliefs or healthcare utilization.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) found that an asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program was feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis on background antifibrotic therapy.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Complete Guide to Clean Claims for Rehab Therapy Billing
item.description: This guide by WebPT provides a complete overview of the claims creation process to help rehabilitation therapy clinics achieve clean claims and reduce denials.
item.author: WebPT

item.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
item.description: A double-blind RCT (N=56) found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability in adults with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, compared to sham rTMS plus VR over 8 weeks.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Prior Authorization for Certain Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) Services
item.description: CMS established a nationwide prior authorization process for certain hospital outpatient department (OPD) services through the Calendar Year 2020 Outpatient Prospective Payment System/Ambulatory Surgical Center Final Rule, aimed at controlling unnecessary volume increases and protecting the Medicare Trust Fund.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Epidemiological burden and associated factors of shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players: a systematic review
item.description: A systematic review on shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players, published in BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation, details the epidemiological burden and associated factors of these injuries.
item.author: BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil
